summary: Tested new backup deletion feature for gallery and file delete flows. All 12 backend tests pass (100%). Frontend delete dialogs correctly show 'Also delete from backup?' checkbox with proper data-testids. Checkbox toggles correctly and button text changes to 'Delete + Backup' when checked. Cancel closes dialog without deleting. All regression tests pass.
